items.title: Objection (Widerspruch) against care level 2 decision
items.quote: Halten Sie die Entscheidung für falsch, legen Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids Widerspruch ein – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Pflegekasse bei der Beispiel Ersatzkasse.
items.computation: Letter dated 28.03.2025 (Fri), no separate posting date. Pflegekasse is a social-law body (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X): deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting = Tue 01.04.2025 (no weekend/holiday shift needed). Period of one month, start day not counted: ends Thu 01.05.2025. 1 May is a public holiday (Labour Day), so under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 64 Abs. 3 SGG the period ends on the next working day, Fri 02.05.2025.

warnings: The deadline is calculated from the deemed delivery date (1 April 2025); if you want to be safe, file the objection earlier, and a later actual receipt does not extend the period.
The letter grants care level 2 instead of the applied-for level 3; if you disagree, the objection must reach the Pflegekasse (or another domestic authority or social insurance body) by the deadline.
